original_text:
This is my updated resume having an 𝗔𝗧𝗦 𝗦𝗰𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝟵𝟬

Here are some strategies I followed while creating this 👇

→ Removed my photograph and personal details.

→ Kept the resume to one page since my experience is less than 4-5 years.

→ Used readable fonts like Arial and Calibri.

→ Eliminated all spelling and grammatical errors.

→ Avoided partitioning the resume for a smoother read.

→ Used bullet points in the work experience section instead of paragraphs.

→ Added relevant keywords based on the job description.

→ My mobile number, email address, LinkedIn, and GitHub are at the top.

→ Used metrics and numbers to quantify the impact of my work.

→ Focused on four key sections: Technical Skills, Work Experience, Education, and Personal Projects/Certifications.

After making these changes, I got it reviewed by a Senior Data Engineer, who optimized it further. That's when I realized that despite focusing on key areas, I still missed things like tailoring the skills section.

So before you hit that submit button, get it reviewed by a data mentor at top companies.

𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗲𝗰𝘁 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗺 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗙𝗥𝗘𝗘 𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲: 
https://lnkd.in/gRRQK9Fn

They have been on both sides of the hiring table and will improve your resume based on current hiring trends. They’ll also guide you in building relevant projects, strengthening your skills, and preparing you for interviews. 🚀

If you've read so far, do LIKE the post 👍

#dataengineering #collab #preplacedcollab
…see more

ai_analysis.summary: This is a promotional LinkedIn post about resume optimization for candidates with less than four to five years of experience. It claims the author's resume received an ATS score above 30 and lists general formatting and content strategies, including removing personal details, keeping the resume to one page, using readable fonts, correcting errors, avoiding multi-column layouts, using bullets, adding job-description keywords, placing contact details at the top, quantifying impact with metrics, and emphasizing technical skills, work experience, education, and projects or certifications. The post also says that senior or mentor review helped the author identify the need to tailor the skills section, then advertises a paid resume-review service. It contains no technical data engineering knowledge.
